content:
tara: Drafting a compact manager kickoff checklist for the first week + 30/60/90 expectations. Keeping it actionable — can folks skim and flag anything missing?

kevin: skimming now. looks good from a product perspective. one quick ask: add a customer-shadow or support-ridealong in week 2. helps with context.

tara: good call, @kevin — will add a customer shadow in Week 2. also planning to make security training a 48h deadline.

indra: quick note — please add the benefits/new-hire payroll link. here's the canonical page: https://companywiki/internal/benefits (will update if it moves).

mike: can we include a short engineering onboarding checklist (dev env + access) so managers can help unblock new hires faster? snippet below might work.

```
Dev quickstart (share with new hire):
- Request access: monorepo, CI, infra dashboards
- Clone + install: git clone git@repo:org/infra.git && make bootstrap
- Run tests: ./ci/run_local_tests.sh
- Join #eng-dev for install help
```

kevin: also add a line about scheduling the first skip-level intro within week 1 — helps with visibility.

tara: OK — here's the full condensed checklist I'm proposing. feedback welcome, then I'll push to Notion and the manager template.

```
Manager first-week condensed checklist
Pre-start (Week0):
- IT ticket for laptop + VPN + SSO created
- Assign buddy (peer) and add to calendar
- Share role doc, OKRs, team roadmap links
- Create Day1 calendar with HR, team intro, and tech setup
Day1:
- 30m HR runthrough (payroll, benefits, policies)
- Team intro (15m) + add to team roster
- Dev env kickstart + access verification with eng buddy
- Set up recurring 1:1s (manager->new hire) + skip-level
By EOW (Day5):
- New hire can run tests locally and open PR
- Manager assigns first small deliverable (doc/bug/triage)
- 30/60/90 draft shared with manager and new hire
- Security training scheduled (complete within 48h)
Week2:
- Customer shadow / support ridealong (context)
- Stakeholder intro meetings (product/ops/sales as relevant)
- Checkpoint: dev env + tooling fully functional
30/60/90 expectations (manager-owned):
- 30 days: onboarding tasks complete, first small feature or fix delivered, feedback loop set
- 60 days: cross-team collaboration, measurable contribution to roadmap
- 90 days: shipping meaningful work, propose next-quarter goal, calibration with manager
```

indra: this reads great. can we make the benefits/payroll doc a pinned link in the Notion template? makes life easier.

mike: +1 on pinned links. also suggest a brief agenda for the first manager->new-hire 1:1: expectations, communication prefs, immediate blockers, three-week goals.

kevin: :thumbsup: add a line to mention mandatory compliance certs (privacy/security) where applicable.

onboard-bot: Reminder: Day1 checklist will be sent to the hiring manager and buddy 24 hours before new hire start date.

tara: thanks all — I'll incorporate suggestions (customer shadow, pinned links, 1:1 agenda, compliance note). finalizing and will update Notion template and the manager email template. @indra can you confirm payroll step wording once updated?

indra: confirmed. small wording tweak pushed to the doc — "Payroll enrollment required within first 3 business days."

kevin: looks ready to me. thanks @tara and team.

tara: thanks — publishing now. if anyone wants to add a role-specific checklist (e.g., infra, support, sales managers), please DM me and I'll create variants.

mike: will do for infra.

kevin: thanks everyone.
_notes: Single-thread Slack export style: messages in chronological order, short messages, mentions, emoji, code blocks allowed. No title field per agents.md.
